_comment: A mint-accent brand on near-black ink. A brand is only these tokens -- copy this file, change the four colours and the two font paths, and every template draws that company's card instead. Keep one accent across cards, lower thirds and badges: that is what makes a film read as one channel rather than three.
_note: radius_px 0 is deliberate: hard rectangles give the wipe a clean edge to travel along. Round them for a softer card, but check the wipe again -- a large radius makes the reveal look ragged.
